segments.text: of the 7.2 trillion peso budget is already determined by laws,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: formula, and existing obligations before government even begins deciding

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: which new or expanded programs to fund.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Meanwhile,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: unprogrammed appropriations have been significantly reduced to just 112 billion pesos,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the lowest NEP proposal nominally since 2019,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and at only 1.56% of the total expenditure program,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: likewise the lowest UA to total expenditure program ratio since 1991.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: And for the benefit of our kababayans who are watching this briefing live,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: please allow me to note that the inclusion of unprogrammed appropriations in the budget

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: does not mean that the amount is automatically available for release.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: It is a standby spending authority for specifically identified purposes

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: that may be accessed only when the funding conditions prescribed by law are satisfied.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the proposed UA has been deliberately narrowed primarily to finance,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: partially the restoration of the fund balance previously remitted by the Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: as well as to support foreign-assisted projects,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: which are still currently being assessed and evaluated by the Investment Coordination Committee

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and eventually for approval by the ED Council.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This reflects the administration's conscious policy choice

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to put more expenditures under programmed appropriations

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: where funding is clearer and more predictable

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: while keeping standby appropriations to the minimum necessary.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: The proposed fiscal year 2027

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: national budget was prepared on the basis of agencies' funding requirements

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and with close consideration of their budget utilization and implementation capacity.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: As of June 30, 2026,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: total available appropriations had reached P7.54 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: of which P6.63 trillion had already been released

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: as allotments to various agencies,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: including P546.79 billion from continuing appropriations from fiscal year 2025.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Of these allotments,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: agencies had already obligated P3.29 trillion or 49.5%,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: comprising P3.13 trillion from fiscal year 2026 appropriations

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and P158.58 billion from fiscal year 2025 continuing appropriations.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: In terms of disbursements,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: 81.9% of the reported obligations have been paid.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Meanwhile, unreleased appropriations amounted to P820.21 billion

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: as of June 30 from the fiscal year 2026 GAA

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and P89.7 billion

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: from fiscal year 2025 continuing appropriations.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: These data have guided our budget preparation process

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and reinforced the need to align future allocations

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: with agencies' implementation capacity.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This reflects our commitment to ensuring that budgets

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: are not only approved and released,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: but effectively implemented,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: because every peso delivers its true value

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: only when it is translated into timely,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: measurable, and meaningful outcomes for the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: By expense class,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: reflects a disciplined spending strategy

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to sustain government operations,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: invest in long-term development,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and fulfill our fiscal obligations.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Maintenance and other operating expenses, or MOOE,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: will receive P2.944 trillion.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: In addition,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: reflects a 1.2% decrease from the fiscal year 2027 GAA

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: despite the 6% overall increase in the national budget.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: In absolute terms,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: MOOE actually decreases by P36.2 billion.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This shows that growth of the budget is not driven

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: by a broad expansion in operating expenditures.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We have allocated P1.982 trillion

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: for personnel services,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: an increase of P138.2 billion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to support the public servants who deliver education,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: health care, public safety, national defense,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and other essential services.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This also reflects salary adjustments

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and other personnel requirements

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: already committed by the government.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Notably, PS and MOOE remain fully covered

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: by our projected revenues,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: reinforcing our commitment to fiscal discipline.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Meanwhile, capital outlays increased to P1.16 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: up by P140.8 billion, or 13.8%,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: allowing government to invest in infrastructure,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: equipment, facilities, and other assets

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: with long-term economic and social value.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Financial expenses amount to P1.114 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: up by P164.3 billion, or 17.3%,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: primarily reflecting interest payments.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Allow me to briefly note the context

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: behind the increase in interest payments.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: A higher interest bill does not by itself mean

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: that our debt has become unmanageable.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Our debt remains manageable,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: as previously mentioned by the Secretary of Finance,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and debt servicing is explicitly provided for in the budget.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: At the same time, our medium-term fiscal program

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: is designed to gradually narrow the deficit

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: while protecting growth-enhancing

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and socially important expenditures.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Our approach is therefore not to sacrifice growth

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: simply to reduce the deficit overnight.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We are pursuing a strategic and gradual fiscal consolidation path

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: that allows us to honor our obligations,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: maintain fiscal credibility,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and continue investing in our people and our economy.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: The proposed national budget will be allocated across five sectors,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: with the largest share, P34.1%,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: or P2.456 trillion going to social services.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This finances investments that Filipinos encounter directly

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: in their everyday lives.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Education, health, social protection,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: employment, housing, and other essential services.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Economic services will receive 25.5%,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: or P1.833 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: supporting infrastructure, agriculture,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: transportation, water resources,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: digital connectivity, and other productivity-enhancing investments.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: General public services will receive 18.3%,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: or P1.317 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: while defense will receive 6.3%,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: or P452.4 billion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: as we strengthen our capacity to protect our territory,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: our communities, and our people.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Meanwhile, 15.9%, or P1.143 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: is allocated for debt burden,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: covering interest payments and net lending

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to government corporations.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Again, debt service should be viewed in its proper context.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Meeting our obligations protects the government's creditworthiness,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: preserves investor confidence,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and helps keep financing available for future public investments.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: The important point is balance.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We honor what we owe while continuing to invest

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: in what our people need.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: By recipient unit,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: national government agencies will receive the largest share

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: at P4.332 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: enabling them to implement priority programs and projects nationwide.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: But even as NGAs receive the largest nominal share,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: their allocation grows by only 4.5%,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: below the overall 6% growth of the national budget,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: again reflecting restraint in national government spending.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Local government units will receive P1.533 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: recognizing their critical role in delivering frontline services

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and responding to the needs of local communities.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: A major component is the P1.32 trillion NTA,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: compared with around P1.191 trillion this year,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: an increase of roughly P129.3 billion

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: flowing directly to our local government units.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We have also provided P220.5 billion for GOCCs

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and P1.14 trillion for interest payments.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This distribution shows that the budget is not concentrated

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: solely in the national bureaucracy.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: A substantial and growing amount is being transferred to the local level

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: where many government services are actually delivered to our citizens.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This brings us to another important dimension

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: of the budget, where the money will go.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Of the proposed fiscal year 2027 national budget,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: P4.603 trillion or 63.9% will be directly allocated

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to the regions to support programs and projects

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: responsive to local development priorities.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Of this amount, National Capital Region will receive P1.112 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Luzon at P1.659 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Visayas at P744.8 billion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and Mindanao at P1.088 trillion.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: The remaining 36.1% or P2.597 trillion

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: constitutes the non-regionalized budget.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This consists of nationwide allocations

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: amounting to P1.983 trillion or 27.5%

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and central office allocations totaling

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to P213.8 billion or 8.5%.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: But nationwide should not be mistaken for Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: These include resources that will eventually benefit regions

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and beneficiaries across the country

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: but cannot yet be geographically assigned

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: at the time the NEP is prepared.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: The broader direction is that the majority of the budget

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: is intended to reach our regions and communities.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This is what we mean when we say

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Bawat Bayan Makikinabang.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: With the overall framework and dimensions of the budget laid out,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: let us now look more closely at where some of our biggest investments will go.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: The Department of Education will receive the highest allocation

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: at P975.96 billion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: affirming the government's enduring commitment

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to investing in our people.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: But beyond basic education,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the proposed budget allocates

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: P176.5 billion for higher education

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to ensure that more Filipinos have access to quality

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and affordable tertiary education.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Altogether, the proposed investment in basic and higher education

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: amounts to P1.326 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: equivalent to nearly 4% of GDP,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: effectively reaching the lower bound

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: of the UNESCO Education 2030 benchmark

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Within these totals are very concrete investments.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We are proposing P12.09 billion

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: for the expanded career progression system

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: for public school teachers,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: nearly double the fiscal year 2026 level,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to support the reclassification

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and career advancement of our teachers.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This reflects an increase of P5.94 billion

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: or 96.6% from the fiscal year 2026 level.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We are providing P10.36 billion

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: for the teaching allowance,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: sustaining the P10,000 allowance provided

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: under the Kabalikat sa Pagtuturo Act.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: For tertiary education,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: P61.1 billion is provided

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: for the universal access

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to quality tertiary education

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: across SUCs,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: CHED, and TESDA,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: supporting free higher education,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: tertiary education subsidies,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and free technical vocational education.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: More than maintaining institutions,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: these investments focus more

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: on addressing learning losses,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: supporting our teachers,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: keeping young Filipinos in school,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: improving skills,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and building the human capital

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: that will determine our country's competitiveness

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: for decades to come.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Now, let's look more closely

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: at where the money goes

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and which priorities receive

segments.text: the largest departmental allocations.

segments.text: account for 51.4%

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: of the proposed national budget,

segments.text: reflecting the administration's major priorities

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: At the top, like I mentioned,

segments.text: is the Department of Education

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: with P975.96 billion,

segments.text: followed by the Department of Public Works

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and Highways with 644 billion.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Substantial investments

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: are likewise proposed for health,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: interior and local government,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: national defense,

segments.text: May I clarify to which agency that question is directed?

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Secretary Balisacan, sa DepDev, Madam.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Yes, the household spending sa kuryente is quite sensitive sa price of electricity.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: The share of electricity...

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: The share of electricity cost, expenditures of a typical household, an average household in the Philippines is 5.3%.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: And that represents about something like 17,057 pesos per year.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Average, you know, it's much lower for the lower income groups.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Salamat po sa inyong tugon, Sekretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Isa pang tanong na lang po, para mas maunawa na rin namin dito sa Kongreso,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: nais ko po sanang makuha ang kasagutan ng aking susunod na tanong sa Central Bank of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Nandito po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Since the prices of our goods and services are largely dependent on the prices of electricity,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: kasi ang mga industrial at mga mamarati,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: mga manufacturing sectors ay gumagamit din ng electricity and geoproduction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Kumbaga, interrelated po ang mga sektor na ito sa paggalaw ng kuryente sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Habang pataas ng pataas ang kuryente, pataas din ng pataas ang presyo ng bilihin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Dahil kailangan may pasa ito ng mga sektor sa nabanggit kong mga consumers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: At ang pagdaloy o...

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: pass-through ay nagdudulot ng pagtaas na inflation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: How does the Banko Sentral ng Pilipinas resolve these issues of rising inflation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Deputy Governor, may please respond.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Talaga naman hong sinusubaybayan rin namin yung mga paggalaw ng iba't ibang components noong ating Consumer Price Index.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Kung saan.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Kung saan yun yung nagiging batayan sa pag-compute noong ating inflation rate.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Isa na ho dito yung sa electricity rates.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: So tinitignan ho namin yun.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: At tinitignan rin ho kung ito ba ay nagdudulot ng tinatawag na spillover sa iba pang mga presyo.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Paggalaw ng mga iba pang presyo na binibili ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ito ho ay...

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Closely, time team na tinitignan ho namin.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Gaya ho nang sinabi namin kanina, ang inflation rate ho at ganoon rin ho yung debt-debt.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Nakita ho na ito ay, ang average ho ay 5% this year.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ngunit nung huling mga dalawang buwan, ito ay 6.4%, 6.2%.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ang iba nito ho ay dulot rin rin noong sinasabi ninyong pag-akyat.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Noong ating inflation, o positive na inflation sa electricity rates.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: So ito ho ay tinitignan namin ng mabuti.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: At sa aming outlook po na binigay kanina,

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: ang pagsusuri ho namin, maaaring mag-average ng 6.4% this year ang ating inflation rate.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Kasama na ho dyan yung epekto noong pagtaas,

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: o yung mataas na...

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: presyo ng krudo sa international na merkado.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: At ito ho, kasama na rin dyan yung epekto ho nito sa ating gasolina at saka sa electricity.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Kaya ho, medyo mataas yung nakikitang average na inflation ho itong taon na to.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. Thank you sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas for that response.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Madam Chair. That's all.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much, Representative Pleyto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We'll now move to our next interpolator from the minority, the Honorable Antonio Tinio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Madam Chair, unang set ng questions tungkol sa sweldo, salary increase.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Matindi ang crisis ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At para sa mga, lalo na mga empleyado sa civilian, para sa kanila sa kapos ang salary increase,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: kahit in-implement ang 3rd tranche and then next year, 4th tranche.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kung DBM ang tatanungin, 4th tranche na next year, kailan ang susunod na round ng salary increase na maasahan?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor, bahagi po ng mandato ng DBM yung patuloy na pag-evaluate po ng ating salary schedule.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: At dito po sa... meron po tayo ngayong ikukomisyon ng ongoing na pag-aaral,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: kahit po meron pa tayo...

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: yung 4th tranche na inaasahang i-implement by 2027,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: particular na nga po precisely because of the point of the Honorable Tinio,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: upang malaman po natin yung magiging susunod na schedule.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, dito po natin sa pag-aaral po malalaman, Madam Chair, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: kung ano po yung magiging timing, amount of increase, if any,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: pagkatapos po ng ating gagawin na compensation study.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kailan po ang study na yan?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Meron po tayo, Your Honor, Madam Chair, na isa sa gawa na study together with the GCG early next year.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This year, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At kailan po maasahan ng result?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We are expecting, Your Honor, a result by the second half of next year, Madam Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Second half of next year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, mula doon, babatay kung may pag... magkakaroon ng...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ng susunod o kailan magkakaroon, ganun ba? At kung magkano?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yes, Madam Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: At sisikapin po natin na if there will be a result of the assessment,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: sisikapin po natin na ito ay makonsidera din sa magiging submission po ng budget for 2028.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Kung magkano man po or kung kailan po yung lalabas doon sa ating pag-aaral.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, if ever 2028 pa. Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Punta tayo sa pera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, marami na po nagsasabi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 2009 pa po, huling natakda yung 2,000 peso sa month na pera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ito ang isang posibleng pagtugon doon sa kakapusan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Dahil nga tumaas ang inflation, sinasabi nyo rin naman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: May posibilidad po ba na magtaas ng pera sa 2027 budget?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor, unlike po yung sa comprehensive salary increase na talagang...

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: nangailangan ng mas malalim na pag-aaral, ito pong posibilidad ng pag-increase ng pera.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Ginagawa po ngayon ang pag-aaral ngayon na po mismo ng DBM

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: upang kami po ay makapagbigay ng necessary recommendation sa ating presidente

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: kung magkakaroon man po ng adjustment sa pera ay kung hanggang saan po yung ire-recommend ang increase.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Ito pong pag-aaral tungkol sa pera, ang tinatarget po natin ay makapagkaroon po tayo ng recommendation sa ating presidente.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Bago po matapos itong taon na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: For implementation in 2027?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yun po ang isang target, Madam Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Kung magkakaroon man po ng adjustment sa pera, ito po ay ating sisikapi na ma-accommodate sa 2027

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: sa ilalim po ng ating Miscellaneous Personal Benefits Fund, Madam Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, so tututukan po natin yan. So 2027, pagtaas ng pera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Iba na ako, mahigpit ang oras natin. Meron po tayong ilang slides.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sigil muna yung time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tumatakbo yung oras, Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, ito na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, so kaugnay sa flood control, of course, yan ang nasa isip ng mamamayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Especially in 2023, 2024, and 2025, talagang lumobo ng gusto ang pondo sa flood control

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: at malaki ang dahilan niyan, isang malaking dahilan niyan, yung congressional insertions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ngayon, sa congressional insertions, para mangyari yan, para madagdagan ng DPWH,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: kailangan may bawasan sa ibang ahensya o pondo. Tama po ba? Di ba ganun?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Susunod po sa zero-sum principle at dahil pareho po ang total ng budget. Tama po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, now, next slide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Meron tayong napansin na pattern at sabihin ko pa nga, modus, ng padding under the neb.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Padding of certain items.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ito yung over the years, palaging malaki sa NEP, tapos pagdating sa GAA, lumiliit na significantly.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At sa tingin natin, ito yung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ito yung pinanggagalingan, o ito yung, this is what enables massive insertions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ano po ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Isa dyan, yung mga foreign assisted projects sa DOTR at saka sa DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: I will not detail it too much, pero nakikita nyo, yung padding or buffer na sinasabi dyan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: umaabot sa for 2026, for example.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nag-propose kayo sa NEP under DOTR ng foreign assisted, 135 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa GAA, naging 64 billion na lang ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And you can work back by mas malalaki pang examples ng padding dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Next slide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Isa pang ginagamit for padding, for insertions, ay miscellaneous personnel benefits fund and pension and gratuity fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang pattern over the years, napakalaki.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nang sinasabmit nyo sa NEP, tapos pagdating sa GAA, napaka significantly less.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And ngayon, ang tanong po ay notable ngayon sa DOTR, napakalaki po nang sinabit nyong additional budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: From 84 billion to something like almost 300 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At malaki doon ay foreign assisted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ang tanong ko, mauulit na naman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano naman ba ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang laki sa simula, nung proposal nyo, tapos sa dulo, maliit na yan, at ginamit na yung fiscal space for insertions.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor, on the part of the DBM, we most respectfully submit na yun pong amounts that we propose in the NEP

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: ay naaayon po doon sa aming evaluated requirement para po sa mga foreign assisted projects na ito.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, in fact, ngayon po hawak ko yung detalye, mas mababa pa po yung aming proposed level sa NEP kung ikukumpara po sa actual agency proposal.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: As to the point, Madam Chair, Your Honor, na kung bakit po ito ay eventually nababawasan, we most respectfully submit.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: In fact, Your Honor, ito po yung reason, one of the reasons kung bakit din po nadidelay yung implementation ng ating mga foreign assisted projects.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Dahil po on the part of the executive, yun pong aming submitted.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: At yung foreign assisted level po talaga yung sa tingin naming kinakailangan para masiguro pong on track and on time yung implementation ng ating iba't ibang mga foreign assisted projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Well, anyway, ang punto, nakatutok po tayo sa mga pondong yan at tignan natin kung ano mangyayari sa dulo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang tanong ko po, magkakaroon na naman po ba ng massive insertion sa budget na ito?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor, in as much as we have already submitted the NEP, sa amin po ay nasa kongreso na po ang kapalaran po ng National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, hindi kayo magsasubmit ng IRATA?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: As far as the DBM is concerned, Your Honor, wala po kami ngayong pinag-uusap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, next slide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Next slide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kaugnay sa flood control.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang isang kapansin-pansin po ay binalik po ang flood control ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang isang napansin po natin dito sa listahan ng DBM ay, next slide,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: out of 197 district engineering offices, kung flood control lang, 113 lang po na DEO ang merong flood control projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ngayon, bakit ganun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sabi na, baka wala, hindi kayo isubmit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kailangan ng ibang distrito yung flood control projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: But, isang kapansin-pansin po, the whole of Region 11, meaning the Davao region, wala po ni isang flood control projects, blanco po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: If you can go back to the previous, ayan, o, kita niyo may blanco dun sa Region 11.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nagtataka kami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kasi binabaha naman sa Davao, alam natin, pero wala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Bakit po ganun?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor, ang naging assessment at evaluation po ng DBM ay nakabatay po doon sa proposal na ipinadala ng DPWH.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, on our part po, Madam Chair, Your Honor, kung wala pong proposal na ipinadala from DPWH, ay wala rin po kaming i-evaluate.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, probably on this question, Madam Chair, Your Honor, we can also defer later on to DPWH

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: para mabigyan po ng mas malinaw na paliwanag kung,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: bakit hindi po, kung meron pong gaps na ganito po na na-observe.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Well, nagtataka po tayo, no, dahil hindi lang naman Davao region, pero ito buong region.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: No, sabi ko nga, there are 47 regions in total, DEOs, in total na zero.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ang point ko, eh, malamang magsasubmit pa yan, di ba, at magkakaroon ng irata.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, sabi nyo kanina, walang irata as far as you're concerned.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: We shall see.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. In other words, ang pangamba natin dito ay magkakaroon na naman ng insertions

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: at yung sinasabing yung reforms na may vetting and so on and so forth, ay hindi mangyayari pagkaganon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Now, another question, yung sinabi ni Secretary Bonoan na may leadership fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Meron po ba ang leadership fund dito sa budget na ito?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Wala po, Madam Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Wala po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Wala po. Okay. Balik po sa kaninang slide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Bakit po sa DPWH budget, flood control lang ito, merong nakalodge sa central office na as much as 40, is that 49 billion pesos?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tapos, sabi nyo kanina, yung mga nasa central office, yung hindi pa ma-allocate to the regions at the time of budget preparation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: However, that's not true because as you can see, yung nasa central office, ay nakadistribute din sa regions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Bakit ganyan ang budget nyo? Merong nasa regions, tapos merong nasa central office, pero may region din.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: To the Honorable Tinio, may we request that to be the last question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Sige po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, we'll request Secretary Kim de Leon to respond and then we'll move to the next interpellator.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor, isa pong malaking bahagi.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Ang mga proyektong na kailalim po sa central office ay itong ating mga foreign-assisted projects.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: By default po, Madam Chair, Your Honor, hindi lang po sa DPWH, gayon din po sa iba pang mga ahensya, kapag po foreign-assisted project, ito po ay nakatag under sa respective central offices.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, yung balansi po nito, ito po ay mga proyekto na isinumiti po ng DPWH and they properly tag it po sa central office based on their respective assessments.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: I can assure you, these are not...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: These are not foreign-assisted projects. Walang pinag-iba yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mga tig-150, tig-80 million na flood control projects, walang pinag-iba sa mga project ng distrito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, I will... Ako, ang sasabihin ko, yan yung leadership fund na nasa central office.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Yamang ganun, ang punto ko po rito ay binalik ang flood control, pero dating gawi pa rin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: No? Nandyan pa rin yung mga iniintay, nakaabang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Para sa insertions at merong allocation na tinawag ni Bonoan na leadership fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ang huling punto ko na lang po, Madam Chair, ay malinaw para sa kinatawang ito na walang anumang substantial na pagbabago sa proseso ng pagpondo, pag-identify pagpondo ng flood control projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Therefore, dapat hindi pa ito ibalik sa kasalukuyang budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tip na flood control, dapat ilagay sa classrooms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: No?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: My very last slide, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang target na sa inyong budget, ang target na ipatay yun yung classroom for this year is, for next year, 2027, is 700.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, nagbalik kayo ng mahigit 100 billion in flood control.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Samantala, ang target...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ayan, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nakalagay mismo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: The target na classrooms na gusto niyong ipatayo para sa taong ito ay 700 lamang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Representative Tinio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ang punto po, sa halip na flood control, ilagay ang pondo sa classroom dahil 160,000 ang shortage ng classrooms, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Representative Tinio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: That would be the last question for this round.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: A response from...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Can you explain?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: A response lang po, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: If Secretary De Leon would like to respond shortly, like a brief response to the query of Hon. Pleyto.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor, dalawang mahalagang factor po patungkol po sa budget sa classroom.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Una po, yun pong 2026 budget of DepEd for classroom, yung kanilang absorptive capacity.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Ngayong second half pa lang po sila nag-uumpisang ma-implement yung kanilang nakalaang budget po para sa kanila na inaasahan pong magsispeel over.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Hanggang 2026.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Ang pangalawa pong mahalagang factor, Madam Chair, Your Honor, is by 2027, meron din po tayong isang package ng classroom infrastructure, school infrastructure project na tinatarget po nating ma-implement through a public-private partnership.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So ito po ay meron po tayong target na ah ito po yung PIP 3 na may estimated project cost na 105.7 billion na labas po on top po of our general appropriations act being a public

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: private partnership. Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. Pag ah flood pag classroom hirap ma-implement pag flood control parang hindi. Yun lang po ang last comment ko, Madam Chair. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Again, sorry we've given you like 6 minutes 6 minutes 42 seconds over the time. So we move to the next interpellator from the majority representative Ryan Ro. Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Hello. Hello. Uh, good afternoon everyone. Oh, sorry.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Thank you po, Madam, Madam Chair. Thank you. I just have a question lang po to the DBM. Yes. Um, my question has to do with underspending and bottlenecks. Uh because the context of my question is our economy has slowed down by 2.3% second quarter of 2026. And the proposal currently increases

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: capital outlays by 13.8% but at the same time uh we have an issue with underspending and we based on our own calculations rin here yung uh ah there were resources that were shifted from GOCCs, nilagay po sa DPWH 27.33% to be exact. So yung tanong ko lang po is what mechanisms do we have in place

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: to to prevent underspending because we're increasing the budget but we haven't seemed to have solved the issue yet of underspending. So Secretary Kim, if you would enlighten us, please.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Chair. Your Honor. Isa po sa napakahalagang pagbabago po na isinagawa po natin and when we talk about infrastructure projects, ito pong mga proyekto na nasa 2027 NEP gaya po ng nabanggit ko kanina already underwent a scrutiny in terms of completeness of documentary requirements.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, ano po yung implication pag nasabi natin these projects have completed documentary requirements?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This means that the agencies responsible, not only DPWH but all the other agencies with infrastructure projects can actually undertake early procurement.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Because if we will observe, this is one thing that actually contributed to the delayed implementation of the infrastructure this year.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: The late procurement for the infrastructure projects, that's why nakita po natin yung effects.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Sa economic growth for the last two quarters.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, with the documentary requirements for 2027 projects complete and ongoing at this early, the agencies can actually start early procurement so that once the budget is passed, hoping that these proposals will be carried by Congress as early as January, they can proceed with awarding and immediate implementation of the respective infrastructure projects, Your Honor, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: So, follow-up lang po, Secretary Kim.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: So, that mechanism...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: So, that mechanism will extend, of course, na rin to next year, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: That will be standard operating practice na po for the coming years, sir?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: That is correct, Madam Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Thank you, Secretary Kim.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: My next question lang po is to the DOF, Secretary Go.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Madam Chair, I notice in your figures, you projected an increase in revenue collections, quite optimistic, from 2026 to 2030.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: However, given the...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: In the context now of, nabanggat niyo po kanina, Mr. Secretary, yung progress bill that has around 85 billion in terms of revenue loss, kasi tatasin po natin yung threshold for personal income tax, tas magiging exempt po yung minimum corporate income tax.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: But at the same time, excise taxes, you have the excise taxes will be increased, not just for sweetened beverages, but for vape products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: And among a lot of other things po, has those...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: My understanding also is that currently there is...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Talks aren't even finished yet with regards to specific tax rates, like for vape, for example.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Nothing is final yet.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Have those considerations been included in the revenue collection calculations for next year at least, too, and even the year after that, Mr. Secretary?

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: The answer is we have not included the revenues from the proposed measures, revenue enhancing measures, and revenue eroding measures in progress.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: They are not included in the projections that we have submitted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Do we still expect collections to be...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: To arrive at a good amount, given that, sir?

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Your Honor, Madam Chair, a lot of it will depend on how the legislature finalizes the proposed numbers in the progress bill.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: You are correct that there are essentially three measures that are revenue enhancing.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: They affect social, environmental, and health taxes.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: And, of course, we proposed a level of taxation, but we are very much aware that that will be subjected to intense...

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Intense...

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Scrutiny and intense discussions.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: So, I think we will not be able to answer that question until after all the deliberations on progress have been made.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: And thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: My next question would be to the Banko Sentral ng Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: You've posed inflation targets from 6.4 this year to 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: It will go down to 4.5 and then in 2028, it will be 3.1.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Isn't that a little too optimistic?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Because DepDev mentioned earlier, we have all of these other external circumstances hindering economic growth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: You have not just our domestic risks like underspending, but you still have the unresolved crisis in the Middle East,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: global trade uncertainty, and volatile global capital flows.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: What is your basis for setting targets for the downward trend in inflation from 4.5 to 3?

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: So, what we...

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ang ibinahagi ho namin kanina dun sa ating slides na 6.4 average inflation para sa taong ito, 2026,

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: At 3.1% sa 2028, ito ho yung ating projections na ginawa noong huling Monetary Policy Meeting ng BSP.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ito ho ay nangyari noong mga kalagitnaan ho ng Hunyo, 2026.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ito ho ay isang forecast na ina-update namin every time na nag-meet ang Monetary Board ng BSP.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: [unclear]

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ang target ho natin ay nananatiling 3% average inflation plus minus 1% na tolerance range.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ngayon, hindi nagbabago yung target pero ang meron kami ay yung forecast natin.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Tama kayo na ang ating forecast, pababa ho ang trend ng ating inflation.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Kung ano ito, mataas yung inflation na nakikita natin dahil mas mataas siya sa 3% para sa taon na ito at sa 2027.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ngayon, ano yung aming tinitignan na pwedeng maka-apekto dito sa ating inflation rate?

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Pababa ho yung ating trend dahil ang nakalagay dyan, isa na rito,

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: pag titignan natin kung ano yung futures prices ng oil.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ito ay mataas pero dahan-dahan bababa.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: So, yun ay nakakatulong dito sa downward trend na ito.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Pangalawa, may mga ginagawa aksyon ng BSP na nakaka-apekto sa medium-term inflation.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ang epekto ng mga huling policy actions ng BSP, inaabot ng 2-3 taon.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ngayong taon na ito, nagtaas kami ng interest rates.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ang total of 50 basis points.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ang inaasahan ho sana namin dito ay ito ay makakapagpigil ng broader price pressures

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: isa-dalawang taon magmula ngayon.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Kahit ho na ito yung aming forecast,

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: pinahayag na rin ho ng Bangko Sentral na may mga risk factors na tinitignan.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Kung bakit maaaring mabagal yung pagbaba or gradual yung pagbaba ng inflation natin.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Isa na ho rito yung presyo ng crudo sa international market.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Pangalawa, yung pwede maging epekto ng El Nino na yung peak impact na ho ay mararanasan pa natin ng fourth quarter

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: until first half of 2027.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: So, yun ho yung mga iba sa mga risk factors na nakikita ng Central Bank na pwede maka-epekto sa inflation natin.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Ito ho ay i-update namin dahil ito ho ay nangyari.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Yung forecast ho ay ginawa nung hunyo pa.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: I-update ho ito next week ho pag nag-meet ulit ang Monetary Board ng Banko Sentral.

segments.speaker: BSP Deputy Governor Zeno Ronald R. Abenoja
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Thank you, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: My concern lang there was I was just wondering if the targets were a little too optimistic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Given all of those risk factors you've mentioned.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Pero good to hear naman po na ma-update naman po yan in the coming months while Congress works on the budget naman rin po also.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Last follow-up question na lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Nabanggit nyo rin po kanina sa presentation po ninyo na yung Dubai crude oil, you're targeting 70 to 90 pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: And then, nung April, the Philippine Institute for Development Studies,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: naglabas po sila ng paper.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: At the time, the Dubai crude oil price was 105 pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: And if this year has taught us anything, a lot of things can happen talaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: May mga contingency plans po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Because the Middle East conflict is not yet over.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: So moving forward, I guess my question is to the DBCC as a whole.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Are there contingency plans in place just in case tumaas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: At nagkakagulo pa ulit sa Middle East, tapos tumaas yung presyo ng crudo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Kasi according to the PID study which I mentioned a while ago,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: 70 to 90 pesos, ah, 70 to 90 dollars, kapag tumaas lang yan to 105 dollars per crude oil,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: that will be 1.4 million Filipinos are in danger of going below the poverty threshold na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: So would you please enlighten the committee?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Thank you po.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor, on the budgetary side,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: yun pong mga line items that we are actually using currently to respond to the oil crisis

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: are actually regular budget line items which are still present in the 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So in the event that there will be a similar event by 2027,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: these line items stand ready to be mobilized to respond to the effects of the calamities,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: including targeted subsidies to the most affected areas.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: And vulnerable populations, some sort of fuel subsidy, including our farmers and fisher folks.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So ito naman po ay kasama po sa pinagandaan natin for the 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Okay. Thank you so much. I believe my time is up. Pero yun na lang po. Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: All right.

segments.text: With that, we will have a break.

segments.text: We'll end.

segments.text: We'll end our morning session for now.
